title: Add cloud management architecture design reports
body:
Comprehensive architecture design for AI-driven cloud management platform, analyzing all 128 existing Zod protocols and proposing GitHub/Vercel-native DevOps workflows.

## Documents Added

- **`CLOUD_MANAGEMENT_DESIGN.md`** (38KB) - Complete Chinese report covering strategic positioning, technical architecture, and 4-phase implementation roadmap
- **`CLOUD_MANAGEMENT_DESIGN_EN.md`** (18KB) - English executive summary for international stakeholders
- **`README.md`** - Updated architecture documentation section with links to new reports

## Key Architecture Proposals

**AI-Native Development**
- DevOps Agent as first-class citizen for autonomous code generation and deployment
- RAG Pipeline integrating best practices from Salesforce, ServiceNow, Kubernetes
- Natural Language Query (NLQ) for requirement-to-deployment in <1 hour

**Cloud Services Integration**
- GitHub: Conventional Commits, auto-PR creation, branch protection, GitHub Actions CI/CD
- Vercel: Multi-region edge deployment (9 global nodes), preview environments per PR, zero-downtime releases
- Complete automation: commit → test → deploy → monitor

**Protocol Analysis**
```yaml
128 Zod Protocols Categorized:
  AI (13):          agent, devops-agent, rag-pipeline, nlq, plugin-development
  API (13):         contract, registry, graphql, odata, websocket
  Integration (7):  github, vercel, database, saas connectors
  System (34):      manifest, plugin, cache, logging, metrics
  Data (12):        object, field, query, validation, driver
  [+ Auth, Automation, Hub, Permission, QA, UI]
```

**Implementation Roadmap**
- Q1 2026: GitHub/Vercel connectors + basic DevOps Agent
- Q2 2026: NLQ + RAG knowledge base + Plugin Development Agent
- Q3 2026: Marketplace launch + official plugin library
- Q4 2026: Enterprise SSO/SAML + private deployment

## Technical Highlights

- **Microkernel architecture** with plugin isolation via service registry
- **Multi-tenant** data/resource/security isolation strategies
- **Global edge deployment** with intelligent routing (GeoDNS, latency-based)
- **AIOps** with anomaly detection, auto-rollback, predictive maintenance
- **Cost optimization** leveraging free tiers + pay-per-use serverless

Reports provide foundation for building cloud-native enterprise management platform with AI-first development workflows.
